title: Dominoes and L-Trominoes on a 2×6 Board | AMC 10-Style Level 4
description:
How many ways can you cover a 2×6 board with dominoes and L-shaped trominoes? Vantee looks at the tile on the top-left square, finds the zigzag blocks, and builds the answer up from short boards in a table. Then a second method with flat and bumpy boards checks it, the traps 13 and 117 get explained, and you get a new tile to try yourself.
